Both sheets print a 'Complete Mailing Address' column HEADER but leave it empty on every row, so donor_city/donor_state are blank because the filer never filled the column - not a redaction. Both sheets carry a '* In Kind' legend at the foot and use a bare asterisk as the in-kind marker; the asterisk sits in the ADDRESS column on Schedule A and beside the PURPOSE cell on Schedule B, and the five marked contributions match the five marked expenditures one-for-one (Ryan Perry/Network Solutions 11.95 x2, Carrie Dickson 2,000.00, Perfect Register 900.00 and 70.00) - the same transactions reported on both sides. Schedule A row 5 is dated 7/18/2005 on a 2006 report - a well-formed filer typo, kept verbatim. Schedule B row 1's date is malformed ('06/20806') and is left blank.
